description: Replace the hand-maintained list of Forward Networks spec URLs with a discovery adapter that fetches https://docs.fwd.app/versions.json, probes /<ver>/api/spec/complete.json for each advertised version, and enumerates per-section spec URLs by scraping /<ver>/api/<section>/ page HTML for /spec/<slug>.{json,yaml} references. Only 26.2 and 26.3 currently publish machine-readable specs — discovery must tolerate archived versions that return 404.

phases.name: Domain: Docusaurus discovery contract
phases.description: Extend SpecSource to include a docusaurus kind with {kind:'docusaurus', baseUrl, sectionPagePattern?}. Pure domain — nothing added to ports/ yet.

tasks.name: Add SpecSource.docusaurus variant
tasks.description: Extend src/core/domain/discovery-types.ts with { kind: 'docusaurus'; baseUrl: string } as a new SpecSource member. No helpers yet — just the type.

phases.name: Secondary adapter
phases.description: New adapter src/adapters/secondary/fwd-discovery-adapter.ts (or generalized docusaurus-discovery-adapter) implementing ApiDiscoveryPort for kind='docusaurus'. Flow: GET /versions.json → parse versions + baseVersions → for each version concurrently HEAD /<ver>/api/spec/complete.json → 200s become DiscoveredVersions. For each version that published complete.json, optionally enumerate per-section spec URLs by scraping the section-index HTML or probing known kebab-case section slugs (checks, networks, nqe, path-search, aliases, credentials, ...).

tasks.name: Implement FwdDiscoveryAdapter.discover()
tasks.description: Fetch versions.json, filter to versions where complete.json HEAD returns 200, return one DiscoveredVersion per (version, section) pair. Timeout: 10s per fetch. User-Agent: 'apidiff-discovery/2.0'. Emit format:'openapi-3.1' for complete.json (already known).

tasks.name: Unit tests with mocked fetch
tasks.description: Mock fetch to simulate: (a) versions.json returns 7 versions, (b) only 2 complete.json probes return 200, (c) 5 others return 404. Assert adapter returns 2 DiscoveredVersion entries. Second test: 26.3/api/checks/ HTML contains /spec/checks.json — adapter extracts it.

phases.name: Wire adapter + migrate registry
phases.description: Register the docusaurus adapter in composition-root. Swap the Forward Networks PROVIDER_REGISTRY entry from kind:'url' (hand-maintained list) to kind:'docusaurus' { baseUrl: 'https://docs.fwd.app' }. Drop the explicit spec-URL list.

tasks.name: Composition-root wiring
tasks.description: src/composition-root.ts registers FwdDiscoveryAdapter keyed on 'docusaurus'. Downstream consumers (apidiff-client, web-adapter) pick it up via the existing ApiDiscoveryPort dispatch.

tasks.name: Migrate Forward Networks registry entry
tasks.description: Replace the ~13 hand-maintained URLs in src/core/domain/provider-registry.ts's Forward entry with { kind: 'docusaurus', baseUrl: 'https://docs.fwd.app' }. Preserves category, slug, docsUrl.
